visuals.heading: Depends on Which Track You Actually Mean

items.text: Most students researching this question are not choosing biomedical science in isolation.
The diagnostics track pays fastest and needs no postgraduate research degree.
A single salary figure, or one relative's opinion about "biomedical science scope," cannot tell you whether this degree fits your specific life.

Are you genuinely comfortable with repeat-and-verify work, running the same test protocol dozens of times a day, or repeating a failed experiment until it works, rather than fast-moving, improvisational problem-solving.
If you want variety and fast-changing daily tasks, the diagnostics track especially will feel repetitive within the first year.
